categories.main_business_segments: Yeahka Limited operates primarily in three business segments: one-stop payment services, merchant solutions, and in-store e-commerce services. These segments collectively provide payment processing, marketing, and digital commerce solutions to merchants and consumers, focusing on seamless payment and value-added services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI and generative technologies, including proprietary AI-powered products such as the Winsfor business intelligence platform and AI Agents for intelligent ordering and marketing. It integrates large AI models like DeepSeek and develops internal AI tools such as Xiaoka Assistant and Y-Copilot coding assistant to enhance operational efficiency, risk management, and customer service. The technology stack supports automated e-store setup, AI content generation, live broadcast planning, and data-driven marketing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yeahka serves a diverse range of merchants including large enterprises, chain stores, and household brands across various verticals such as automotive, luxury goods, beauty, fintech, hospitality, culture, tourism, entertainment, dining, and retail. Key customers include major fintech clients like Ant Group and WeBank, as well as international brands such as Clinique, Bose, Leica, Xiaomi, and Xiabu Xiabu. The company targets merchants requiring integrated payment and value-added digital services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with significant expansion in key Asian markets including Japan, Singapore, and Hong Kong SAR. It has broadened its overseas footprint with a nearly fivefold increase in overseas transaction volume and established strategic partnerships with global banks and international card networks such as Visa, Mastercard, and UnionPay International.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yeahka operates primarily as a midstream technology platform within the payment ecosystem, providing payment processing, merchant solutions, and digital commerce services. It collaborates with upstream suppliers like payment terminal manufacturers and downstream partners including SaaS providers, banks, and independent sales organizations to deliver integrated commerce enablement solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on innovation-driven growth through AI and generative technologies to enhance product competitiveness and operational efficiency. R&D initiatives emphasize AI integration across business lines, development of proprietary AI products for merchants, expansion of global payment networks, and enhancement of value-added services. The company also prioritizes sustainable development and ESG integration in its strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Yeahka generates revenue primarily through transaction fees from one-stop payment services, subscription and service fees from merchant solutions, and fees from in-store e-commerce services. Interest revenue from entrusted loans and small-sized retail loans is included within merchant solutions revenue. The company also benefits from upfront fees in its in-store e-commerce segment, contributing to profitability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yeahka positions itself as a leading payment-based technology platform in China and key Asian markets, maintaining market leadership in one-stop payment services and fintech marketing. It competes with other payment service providers and fintech companies by leveraging AI-driven innovation and comprehensive merchant solutions. The company’s strategic partnerships and broad merchant base strengthen its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yeahka reported revenue of approximately RMB3.09 billion, a 21.9% decrease from 2023, primarily due to macroeconomic factors and industry-wide declines in transaction values. Despite this, gross profit margin improved to 23.6%, and profit for the year increased over sixfold to RMB73 million. The company’s overseas transaction volume grew nearly fivefold, and adjusted EBITDA was RMB384.5 million, reflecting a focus on profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yeahka differentiates itself by offering a comprehensive, AI-powered one-stop commerce enablement platform that integrates payment processing with advanced merchant solutions and in-store e-commerce services. Its proprietary AI technologies reduce costs, increase efficiency, and enhance revenue generation for merchants. The company’s extensive payment network, strategic global partnerships, and focus on high-margin value-added services provide unique customer value and competitive advantage.
